input.narrative: I was at the office all afternoon on Thursday and got home around 7 pm to find the kitchen flooded. The dishwasher supply hose had split. I heard the hose burst at about 2 pm and shut off the water right away, so the water only ran for a few minutes. Even so, the water reached the hallway and the two bedrooms, and the flooring in all three rooms will need replacing. Nothing outside the kitchen was affected.
